questions.stem: The left anterior descending (LAD) artery primarily supplies:
options: Anterior wall and anterior two-thirds of the septum
questions.explanation: The LAD supplies the anterior wall, the anterior septum, and the apex. The RCA usually supplies the inferior wall, and the circumflex supplies the lateral wall.

questions.stem: Coronary artery dominance is determined by which artery gives rise to the:
questions.explanation: Dominance is defined by which artery gives rise to the posterior descending artery (PDA). About 70-80% of people are right dominant, meaning the PDA comes from the RCA.

questions.stem: Most coronary blood flow to the left ventricle occurs during:
questions.explanation: During systole, the contracting LV myocardium compresses the intramural coronary vessels. Most LV perfusion therefore happens in diastole. This is why tachycardia, which shortens diastole, can cause ischemia.
